🔍 Key Takeaways

  • Total Revenue: The business generated $1.28M in revenue with $510.5K in profit from 50,000 transactions.
  • Year-over-Year: Revenue grew by 1.7% from 2023 to 2024. Profit grew by 1.6%.
  • Margin Performance: Average profit margin stands at 40.0%, with a 0.02pp improvement year-over-year.
  • Discounting: 37.5% of transactions used a discount — this is a significant lever worth examining closely in Section 5.

📈 Revenue Trends

  • Peak Month 2023: 2023-01 — $55.7K
  • Peak Month 2024: 2024-06 — $56.0K
  • Strong seasonal patterns visible with clear holiday-driven uplift.
  • 2024 shows growth trajectory vs. 2023.

📝 Order Volume Patterns

  • 2023 Orders: 24,820 total
  • 2024 Orders: 25,180 total (+1.5%)
  • Order volume and revenue correlate strongly (r ≈ 0.93).
  • Monthly AOV remains relatively stable, suggesting volume drives revenue fluctuation rather than price changes.

🏷 Discount Insights

  • Full-price transactions (62.5% of orders) deliver the highest margins at 40.0%.
  • Moderate discounts (1–10%): Margins erode to 40.0% — the strong majority of discounted transactions fall in this range.
  • Heavy discounts (41–50%): Margins collapse to nan% — these represent a small fraction of orders but carry significant margin risk.
  • Actionability: Management should evaluate whether discounts above 20% generate sufficient incremental volume to offset margin erosion. The data suggests diminishing returns on deep discounting.

  • Revenue concentration: The Top 5% of customers by spend generate 14.9% of total revenue — a critically important segment.

  • Strategic implication: Retention and VIP programs targeting the top 5–20% of customers are likely the highest-ROI customer initiatives.
